schema.note: Pinned copy of openapi.json at signed tag v0.4.3 (13 /registry/v2 paths added over the 0.4.0 snapshot; 0.4.1 added fields and filters on /limit-orders/v1/orderbook and /rfqs/v1; nothing removed). The vendored document is the certified snapshot used for live availability diffs; the living reference is served at /docs.

services.meta: GET /v1/meta returns the component name, version, status and commit; every response (health and errors included) carries the x-cork-component version header. Which Distribution a component version belongs to is resolved in this repository, not by the service. Verified 2026-09-15: /meta/v1 -> 0.4.3 @b1c0189.
services.freshness: The indexer can trail the chain head; the chain wins on any disagreement. RFQ state is venue-only by construction (no on-chain events). Registry v2 reads the chain directly (no database) and answers 503 on a chain whose adapter, market creator, pool manager, shares factory and registry do not bind to one deployment.
services.verifyModelNote: This service has exactly one live deployment, updated in place; non-breaking releases keep flowing after the cut. The verify asserts availability: the served version must be >= the pinned version, every covered route family below must remain served at its pinned major, and the live OpenAPI document must show no breaking drift against this vendored snapshot on the covered paths.

routeMajors._note: The covered route families and the major each is certified at. registry is covered at major 2, the MarketRegistry 0.5.0 interface of this Distribution; /registry/v1 (bound to the 0.3.3 registry) is still served but is no longer covered surface. The rollover family is part of the Distribution through its separately pinned rollover component and stays outside cork-api's covered route list by decision of the component owner (2026-09-15).

notices: Review level is unreviewed and stage is partner-preview: no production support commitment attaches to this component version.

The source repository is private by decision; the public interface is this component's vendored OpenAPI document plus the live /docs reference. Integrators verify the running version via GET /v1/meta and the x-cork-component header.

cork-api 0.4.3 is additive over 0.4.0 (same line, z bump): /registry/v2 for Phoenix 1.4.0-rc.1 and MarketRegistry 0.5.0 (registry 0xe1f569f152bdb6ebb2d49cfd9d4ab98ecee955c5 on both chains; oracle_salt and both swap fees required on predict; denominations as address/symbol/name; recipes matched by deployed code hash), 0.4.1's underwriter quote_ref citations, allowedSender on the orderbook, RFQ prefix exclusion and ?underwriter= filter, 0.4.2's per-generation rollover factory admission. No database migrations.

Dependency clearance in this version: fastify 5.12.4, vitest 4.1.11, fast-uri 3.1.8, js-yaml 4.3.2 (all open Dependabot alerts at cut time). Proxy trust moved from a hop count to an address list; client IP resolution behind the load balancer is unchanged.
Canonical path form is /<module>/v<n>. The legacy /v1/<module> rewrite bridge is a migration aid, not part of this pin's covered surface.

Premium convention: POST /limit-orders/v1/ requires `premium_annualized`, an annualized decimal fraction string (for example, `0.041` means 4.1%). The pre-announced legacy percent-number `premium` field was removed on 2026-08-17.

Response fields state their units in the published schema: rates, premiums and fractions follow the documented unit conventions; token amounts are strings in the token's native decimals, never rescaled.
knownIssues: Registry v2 deployment blocks in the service's vendored manifest (Base 51145041, Arbitrum 503851934) are the first-log blocks of the registries; this repository records readback blocks only, so they are not cross-verified here.
